summary: Add marketing_opt_in column to account_user by first adding a nullable BOOLEAN column with database default False (ensuring old version inserts receive False), backfilling existing rows to False, then after retiring the old version, setting the column NOT NULL. deploy_new uses state_only migration as SQL stages own the schema change.
write_consistency: Old version inserts omit the column and receive DB DEFAULT False; new version sets the field explicitly to False. Backfill stage updates all existing rows to False before deploy_new. After deploy_new, both versions' writes result in False, satisfying the no-NULL check during overlap. Contract stage after retire_old ensures no NULLs when making NOT NULL.

stages.description: Add nullable boolean column marketing_opt_in with database default False.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE;

stages.description: Backfill all existing rows with False, clearing NULLs from column addition.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = False WHERE marketing_opt_in IS NULL;

stages.description: Retire old version; after this only new version serves traffic.
Set marketing_opt_in to NOT NULL, finalizing the schema change.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET NOT NULL;
